name: ESP32 Devkit
summary: Integrated ESP32 IoT board with LoRa, RTC, microSD and two relay channels, powered by 220VAC.
description: A single integrated board combining an ESP32 microcontroller (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), a long-range LoRa module, a battery-backed Real-Time Clock (RTC), an I2C interface with selectable 3.3V or 5V levels, two relay channels for controlling AC/DC electrical devices, and a microSD card slot for data logging.
disclaimer: Personal project by Hoàng Duy. Specifications describe the design; manufacturing and qualification results are not published.

overview.text: A single integrated board combining an ESP32 microcontroller (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth), a long-range LoRa module, a battery-backed Real-Time Clock (RTC), an I2C interface with selectable 3.3V or 5V levels, two relay channels for controlling AC/DC electrical devices, and a microSD card slot for data logging.

The entire board operates from a single 220VAC power input, featuring a high-power switching power supply, surge and transient voltage protection, and fuse protection. The integrated supply supports laboratory and field applications without an additional external power module.

overview.title: Key Design Highlight
overview.text: The I2C interface is accessible through a stacked USB-A connector, allowing users to connect I2C sensors using a standard USB cable without requiring specialized connectors. The I2C supply voltage can be selected between 3.3V and 5V using a jumper, enabling direct connection to 3.3V sensors (SHT31, BME280, SEN66, etc.) and compatible 5V sensors without an external level-shifting module. This connector carries I2C signals; it is not a standard USB data port.

featureCards.title: Wi-Fi & IoT-Cloud
featureCards.text: Dual-core ESP32 with 2.4GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth for sending sensor data to an IoT cloud platform.

featureCards.title: Local LoRa network
featureCards.text: Long-range LoRa communication. Reported lab-area testing: 1–1.5 km in an urban environment with trees and buildings; theoretical range: 10–15 km, depending on conditions.

featureCards.title: I2C sensors · 3.3V & 5V
featureCards.text: VCC / SCL / SDA / GND on a stacked USB-A connector. Select the 3.3V or 5V supply with a jumper for compatible sensors.

featureCards.title: UART sensor interface
featureCards.text: Dedicated 5V / Rx / Tx / GND connector for serial sensors and UART communication.

featureCards.title: Battery-backed RTC
featureCards.text: DS3231M real-time clock with a CR1220 backup battery to retain time when main power is lost.

featureCards.title: 2 ON/OFF relay channels
featureCards.text: Omron G5NB-1A relays with optocoupler isolation for controlling AC/DC electrical devices.

featureCards.title: microSD data logging
featureCards.text: On-board microSD slot for logging and storing data, including while the network connection is unavailable.

featureCards.title: 220VAC power input
featureCards.text: Integrated switching supply with surge and transient suppression and fuse protection.
